newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end up 3.15 pct at record high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end up 3.15 pct at record high.

text.p: 1315 GMT - Austria's ATX index ends at record high, boosted by strong international leads and high turnover in preferred shares of Bank Austria after Salomon Brothers upgraded its recommendation to a "strong buy" from "buy".
* 18 ATX shares higher, two lower, one unchanged.
* Leading gainer OMV, up 5.07 percent at 1,740 ats
* Bank Austria preferred shares up 21 schillings at 436 on turnover of 182,719 lots.
* Leading decliner Wolford, down 2.32 percent at 1,220 ats
* August ATX future up 53 points at 1,469
